method: Every physical line was parsed; audit record separators are not newline boundaries. File rules were cross-checked using preprocessed AppArmor policy and a conservative AARE/owner approximation. Non-file records were individually grouped and reviewed. This is not kernel enforcement verification.
null_profiles: Complain-mode generated descendants are attributed to the corrected explicit executable transition, not installed as profile names.
intentional_denials: Packaged Python bytecode writes (131 records): PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE where honored; otherwise optional write failure must fall back to reading installed code.
Direct DRM primary-node probes by media clients (14): render-node access retained; compositor retains primary-node ownership.
Generic application probes of private compatibility modules (2): preserve Zoom/Discord-only import boundary.
One direct unprivileged FUSE mount probe: permit only the scoped setuid clipboard helper, not SYS_ADMIN in the network client.
